title: The Burning Hollow Revisited
author: Yara Whitlock
blurb: Noor Halloran, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
